comment: Manual discovery input. extra_entries: code addresses that are called indirectly but have no relocation or Ghidra function. blacklist: addresses that look like code pointers but are data or markers: 0x401003 is the Watcom ___begtext marker, 0x44cf80 is the string "Sleep" written by a binary patch (a stale relocation points at it). 0x44c3c3 is real code (a get-PC stub followed by a table) and is hand-written in src/reconstructed/watcom_crt.c.
